english.title: Park a heavy commercial vehicle wholly / partly on a footway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) parked a heavy commercial vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), wholly or partly on a footway, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
